block.advancedenchant.enchanting_infuser: Choose, modify and remove enchantments for your gear.
Further increasing the level for this enchantment requires an enchanting table with more enchanting power.
Modifying the level for this enchantment requires an enchanting table with more enchanting power.
This enchantment is too powerful for an enchanting table with such little enchanting power.
gui.advancedenchant.infusing.tooltip.enc: Place more bookshelves in a square around the enchanting table on up to two layers.

advancedenchant.config.remove_incompatib: Allows combining normally incompatible enchantments (e.g. Protection, Blast Protection).
When enabled, allows Protection enchantments on armor and enchanted books to reach level V (5) instead of the vanilla maximum of level IV (4).
